title: agy quota exhaustion is detected by the bridge (pattern_name=exhausted) but never written to cli-health benches — so the working bench-reorder mechanism never fires for agy, and every agy-primary phase (router) pays a guaranteed dead-CLI round-trip on every lane
summary: Observed 4/4 lanes across 2 consecutive waves (cycles 1523/1524 batch-20260818e-verify; 1525/1526 batch-20260819a-verify). The bench-reorder mechanism WORKS and is live — cycle-1525 build phase logged 'cli-health bench reordered chain: [codex-tmux claude-tmux] -> [claude-tmux codex-tmux] (benched: [codex until 05:01 (rate_limit)])'. Router never gets that treatment: .evolve/cli-health.json benches contains ONLY {codex: rate_limit, strikes 14}. agy is absent, despite the bridge capturing 'Individual quota reached. Please upgrade your subscription to increase your limits. Resets in 6h12m56s.' into escalation-report.json with pattern_name=exhausted reason=escalate at 17:02:17Z / 17:28:12Z / 17:39:30Z. Router config is structurally IDENTICAL to builder (cli + 1-element cli_fallback=[claude-tmux]), so this is not a config-shape problem — the bench ledger simply never learns about agy.
root_cause: Two quota-signal paths that do not converge. codex's rate_limit reaches cli-health and is benched (strikes=14, benched_until 05:01). agy's provider-level 'Individual quota reached / Resets in <duration>' is recognized by the bridge escalation matcher (pattern_name=exhausted) and drives a per-dispatch escalate, but that recognition is terminal — it does not record a bench into .evolve/cli-health.json. Consequence: the bench-aware chain reorder (already implemented, already consuming cli-health, already proven live on the build phase) has no bench row for agy and leaves the agy-primary chain in original order, so every router dispatch walks into the wall first.
fix: Make the bridge's exhausted-escalation path write a cli-health bench for the family it just escalated away from, reusing the SAME ledger codex's rate_limit path writes (single-source — do not add a second bench store or a flag). The 'Resets in 6h12m56s' duration in the pane_tail gives benched_until directly; fall back to the existing default bench window when no duration is parseable. Red-first: fixture driving an agy dispatch whose pane matches the exhausted pattern -> assert (a) a bench row for family 'agy' appears in cli-health with a benched_until, and (b) the NEXT dispatch for a profile with cli=agy-tmux + cli_fallback=[claude-tmux] resolves claude-tmux FIRST and emits no pattern_name=exhausted escalation-report. Guard: an unbenched/healthy agy resolves byte-identically to today; codex's existing rate_limit bench path is unchanged.
files: go/internal/bridge/ (escalation matcher — where pattern_name=exhausted is recognized and escalation-report.json is written)
go/internal/core/ (cli-health bench write seam used by the codex rate_limit path — the single source to reuse)
acceptance: An exhausted-pattern escalation writes a cli-health bench row for that family, with benched_until parsed from the pane's reset duration when present.
With agy benched, a router dispatch reorders to claude-tmux first and produces zero pattern_name=exhausted escalation-reports.
Healthy agy resolves byte-identically to today; codex rate_limit bench path unchanged.
Bench state written through the existing seam — no second store, no new flag.
connects_to: cli-health bench reorder (ALREADY LIVE and correct — proven on cycle-1525 build phase; this item only feeds it the missing input)
fleet width degrader (the other proven cli-health consumer: width 3->2 on codex bench)
no-agy-fallback standing rule (agy banned from cli_fallback; here agy is a PRIMARY pin — a different surface of the same hazard, worth a separate look)
zero-generation gate (console branch fix/tmux-prompt-submit-verify) — bounds the compounding 600s cost when the escalation target ALSO transients
notes: Filed per the 2+-occurrence class rule (4/4 lanes, 2 waves). Supersedes two shallower in-session reads of the same symptom: (1) attributing the router exit=81 to the claude 529 alone — the 529 is the SECOND stage and transient, the agy exhaustion is the FIRST and deterministic; (2) proposing to BUILD bench-aware chain resolution — that mechanism already exists and works, the missing piece is only the bench WRITE for agy. Note the exit=81 itself degrades to the static spine and does NOT kill the lane; it costs the cycle its adaptive routing plan (a silent quality regression reported as a WARN), plus up to 600s when the escalation target stalls. IMPACT WIDENED (cycle-1526, live): the class is NOT router-specific. phase=flake-rerun-scan also dispatches agy-tmux as PRIMARY and failed 'agy-tmux@balanced=85 exit=85' before falling back to claude-tmux. Two dispatch shapes exist for the same dead family: (a) a CLEAN exit 85, which IS in the fallback trigger set and recovers fast (cheap — one wasted round-trip), and (b) the pane-matched 'exhausted' escalation whose target then stalls (expensive — up to 600s, see transient-api-error-invisible-inside-artifact-timeout). Benching agy would eliminate BOTH, because the reorder demotes the family before either path is entered. Scope the fix by FAMILY, not by phase. COUNTER-EVIDENCE — DO NOT BENCH NAIVELY (wave batch-20260819b, cycles 1527/1528): agy is INTERMITTENTLY walled, not uniformly dead. cycle-1527's router hit pattern=exhausted and escalated, while cycle-1528's router ran ON agy-tmux and 'exited 0 after 93s' minutes later — same family, same wave, opposite outcomes, both well before the pane's stated 'Resets in 6h12m56s' window had elapsed. So the naive prescription (bench the family until the parsed reset time) would sideline a CLI that demonstrably still serves requests, converting a partial wall into a self-inflicted full outage — and with codex also benched that would drop effective fleet width to 1. REVISED GUIDANCE: treat the exhausted pattern as a DEMOTION signal (move the family to the back of the dispatch chain) rather than a hard bench, or bench with a short probe-and-restore window, and require N strikes before honoring the pane's full reset duration (codex's existing bench carries strikes=14/16, so a strike-count seam already exists to reuse). The core defect stands: the exhausted signal reaches NOTHING today. Only the severity of the response needs to be conservative.
